findings.title: pull-secret prints the registry credential in command output
findings.what: The pull-secret recipe expands $(GHCR_PAT) directly into a recipe line that is not prefixed with @. Make therefore prints the expanded oc command before executing it, disclosing the registry PAT to terminal output and CI logs; the value is also supplied as a command-line argument.
findings.fix: Keep GHCR_PAT as a shell environment variable, suppress recipe echoing, and create the docker config Secret through a protected temporary file or standard input so the token is neither rendered by make nor placed in process arguments; ensure cleanup with a trap.
findings.acceptance: With GHCR_PAT set to a unique sentinel, a dry-run or mocked execution of pull-secret must create the intended Secret while the sentinel appears neither in captured stdout/stderr nor in the invoked command's argument list.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarially re-read probaitio-operator/Makefile:59-64 directly from baseline c8b98a29508b5eb7725c75a7e2a41dfa94c1feba. The recipe lacks @ and uses make-time $(GHCR_PAT) expansion in --docker-password, so make's normal recipe echo deterministically includes the credential. This is current executable configuration, not narrative or a fixture.

findings.title: Downloaded operator tools are made executable without integrity verification
findings.what: The operator-sdk and opm bootstrap targets download release assets with curl and immediately chmod them executable. Neither path checks a pinned SHA-256 digest nor verifies a release signature, so a compromised release asset or delivery path becomes build-host code execution.
findings.fix: Pin an expected digest for every supported OS/architecture and verify the downloaded file with sha256sum -c before chmod/move; download to a temporary file and delete it on verification failure. Signature verification against a pinned trusted key is an acceptable alternative.
findings.acceptance: A bootstrap test using a corrupted or substituted payload must fail at the integrity-check step, leave no executable at $(OPERATOR_SDK) or $(OPM), and never invoke that payload; the authentic pinned payload must pass.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarially re-read probaitio-operator/Makefile:302-317 and :334-349 from the immutable baseline. Both pinned-version URLs flow directly from curl -sSLo to chmod +x with no checksum, signature, digest table, or verification command. The separate go-install-tool path uses Go module version resolution and is not cited as part of this finding.
